setup: CREATE TABLE g06_text_grapheme AS SELECT v, v || i::VARCHAR AS high_v, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN -1 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 1 END AS start_at, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS take FROM (SELECT CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'á👩🏽‍💻Z' WHEN 1 THEN '🇺🇳x' WHEN 2 THEN '♥️é' ELSE '' END AS v, i FROM range(50000) t(i)); CREATE TABLE g06_text_codepoint AS SELECT code, 'p' || chr(code) || chr(0) || 's' AS haystack, chr(code) AS needle FROM (SELECT CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 1 THEN 65 WHEN 2 THEN 129414 ELSE 233 END AS code FROM range(50000) t(i))

workloads.name: g06_1d_grapheme_substring_length_low_cardinality_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(length_grapheme(substring_grapheme(v, start_at, take))) FROM g06_text_grapheme

workloads.name: g06_1d_codepoint_nul_contains_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE contains(haystack, needle)) FROM g06_text_codepoint
